title: Practitioner Exam
description: A fixed 40-question exam drawn at random from a 50-question bank covering all six modules. Pass mark is 80%. This is an open-book exam — take your time, browse any module to refresh your memory, or ask the AI assistant for help. Your answers are saved as you go, so leaving the page to look something up is fine. Explanations show after submission so you can learn from any answers you missed.

questions.prompt: What is CTools?
options: A single dashboard product sold separately
A stack of open-source tools installed on top of the Pentaho Server for building dashboards
A replacement for the Pentaho Server
questions.explanation: Pentaho Community Tools (CTools) are a stack of open-source plugins — CDA, CDF, CDE, CCC, CGG — installed on top of the Pentaho Server.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Getting Started

questions.prompt: Which CTool is the data-access layer for dashboards?
questions.explanation: CDA (Community Data Access) is the abstraction layer between a dashboard and the physical data connections.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Getting Started

questions.scenario: Your team has JavaScript/HTML skills and wants full programmatic control of a dashboard's lifecycle.
questions.prompt: Which tool fits, versus the graphical alternative?
options: CDE for code; CDF for the graphical UI
CDF is the code-first framework; CDE is the graphical editor built on top of it
CCC for code; CGG for the UI
questions.explanation: CDF is the code-first dashboard framework (HTML/CSS/JS); CDE is the graphical editor over CDF for users who prefer not to hand-code.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Getting Started

questions.prompt: What does CCC provide?
options: The charting library (built on Protovis/SVG) for dashboard charts
questions.explanation: Community Chart Components (CCC) is the charting library, built on the Protovis SVG toolkit, used to add charts to dashboards.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Getting Started

questions.prompt: What is the main job of CGG?
options: Rendering CCC charts server-side as images (for reports, limited-SVG browsers, and URLs)
questions.explanation: Community Graphics Generator (CGG) draws CCC charts on the server and converts them to images.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Getting Started

questions.scenario: The 'New CDE Dashboard' option is missing from the Create New menu in PUC.
questions.prompt: What enables it?
options: Uncommenting the relevant blocks in pentaho-cdf-dd's plugin.xml and settings.xml, then restarting the server
questions.explanation: Enabling CDE/CDA means uncommenting the plugin.xml and settings.xml blocks under pentaho-cdf-dd and restarting the Pentaho Server.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Getting Started (Enable CDE & CDA)

questions.prompt: Which tools make up the CTools stack? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: The CTools stack is CDA, CDF, CDE, CCC, and CGG. Schema Workbench is a separate OLAP-schema tool, not a CTool.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Getting Started

questions.prompt: What problem does CDA primarily solve?
options: Unifying access to many data sources behind one abstraction so dashboards consume ready-made datasets
questions.explanation: CDA creates an abstraction layer over different connections, letting a dashboard gather and combine data from several sources into a single structure.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Data Access — Overview

questions.prompt: Which are stated objectives of CDA? (Select all that apply.)
options: Ensure security while accessing data (e.g. avoid SQL injection)
questions.explanation: CDA's three main objectives are combining data from several sources, securing data access, and easing exports.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Getting Started (CDA)

questions.scenario: You need to filter a dashboard query by a month chosen in a drop-down.
questions.prompt: What CDA feature supports this?
options: Parameter-driven queries — the query takes a parameter bound to the selector
questions.explanation: CDA queries accept parameters, so a selector's value (e.g. the chosen month) drives a targeted, parameterised result.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Data Access — Creating a CDA (Parameters)

questions.prompt: Which CDA endpoint runs a query and returns its result set?
questions.explanation: doQuery executes a CDA query and returns the result set (e.g. JSON); listParameters and getCdaList serve other purposes.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Data Access — Creating a CDA (CDA API)

questions.scenario: You must merge the results of two separate queries into one dataset for a component.
questions.prompt: What kind of CDA query do you use?
questions.explanation: A compound query combines two queries with a JOIN or UNION into a single result for a component.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Data Access — Creating a CDA

questions.prompt: Which data-source types can CDA use?
options: SQL, MDX, OLAP4J, Kettle, Scripting, Compound, MQL, XPath, and more
questions.explanation: CDA supports many data-source types — SQL, MDX, OLAP4J, Kettle, Scripting, Compound, MQL, XPath, etc.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Data Access — CDA Data Sources

questions.scenario: A dashboard's data changes hourly but reports still show stale numbers.
questions.prompt: What's the likely cause and tool?
options: The layout is broken; use CDE
CDA query results are cached; clear them via the Cache Manager
The server is off; reinstall it
A parameter is missing; add CCC
questions.explanation: CDA can cache query results for speed; when underlying data changes you clear cached queries via the Cache Manager.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Data Access — CDA Data Sources (Cache)

questions.prompt: A CDA file is, at its core…
options: An XML definition of connections and queries
questions.explanation: A .cda file is XML describing the data connections and the queries (DataAccess elements) the dashboard uses.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Data Access — Creating a CDA

questions.prompt: For quick prototyping of a result set without a database, which CDA data source helps?
questions.explanation: A scripting (Beanshell) data source builds ad-hoc result sets for prototyping without a real database.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Data Access — CDA Data Sources

questions.prompt: How does CDA relate to dashboard components?
options: CDA produces datasets that components consume to display and filter data
questions.explanation: CDA returns dashboard-ready datasets; chart/table/selector components bind to those queries to show and filter data.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Data Access — Overview

questions.prompt: How are CDF dashboards built?
options: By dragging components on a canvas
Code-first, leveraging web technologies (JavaScript, CSS, HTML)
questions.explanation: CDF creates dashboards using web technologies (JS/CSS/HTML), letting the designer control the whole lifecycle without Java.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Framework — Overview

questions.prompt: A CDF dashboard needs which two mandatory files?
options: An .xcdf file and an HTML template it points to
questions.explanation: A CDF dashboard is defined by an .xcdf descriptor (title/author/template/style) that references an HTML template file.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Framework — CDF Dashboard

questions.prompt: What does the CDF framework manage for you?
options: The components' lifecycles and the interactions between them
questions.explanation: CDF manages component lifecycles and the interactions between components, separating HTML design from component definition.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Framework — Overview

questions.prompt: Which are stated advantages of CDF? (Select all that apply.)
options: Uses popular web technologies (Ajax, HTML, CSS3)
Eliminates the need for any data source
questions.explanation: CDF is open-source, uses web technologies, manages lifecycles/interactions, separates design from definition, and is extensible — but dashboards still need data sources.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Getting Started (CDF)

questions.prompt: In the .xcdf descriptor, what does the <template> element specify?
options: The HTML template file that renders the dashboard
questions.explanation: The <template> element names the HTML file (e.g. myFirstDashboard.html) the .xcdf dashboard renders.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Framework — CDF Dashboard

questions.prompt: Where in the HTML template is a component rendered?
options: Into the HTML element whose id matches the component's HtmlObject
questions.explanation: A component renders into the HTML element (div) whose id matches its HtmlObject property.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Framework — CDF Dashboards

questions.prompt: What is the relationship between CDF and CDE?
options: They are competitors with no relationship
CDE is the graphical editor built on the CDF framework — understanding CDF helps you get more from CDE
questions.explanation: CDE builds on CDF; you don't write CDF code in CDE, but CDF's lifecycle concepts still apply.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — Overview

questions.prompt: What does enabling RequireJS support change in a CDF dashboard?
options: It uses AMD module loading to declare and load the dashboard's dependencies
It converts the dashboard to a report
questions.explanation: RequireJS is the AMD module loader; enabling it changes how dashboard code and library dependencies are declared and loaded.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Framework — CDF Dashboards

questions.prompt: What is CDE?
options: A web-based graphical dashboard editor (a Pentaho Server plugin) over the CDF framework
questions.explanation: CDE is a graphical dashboard editor running in the Pentaho Server, providing access to CDF's components without hand-coding.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — Overview

questions.prompt: Which three build perspectives does CDE provide (plus Preview)?
questions.explanation: CDE's perspectives are Layout, Components, and Data Sources, plus Preview to test the dashboard.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — UI Overview

questions.scenario: You're laying out a row with Bootstrap and want a sidebar plus a main area.
questions.prompt: What rule governs the column spans?
options: The columns in a row must add up to 12 spans (e.g. 4 + 8)
Each row must have exactly 2 columns
questions.explanation: With Bootstrap, a row's columns must sum to 12 spans (e.g. 4+8, 3x4). (Blueprint uses 24, but CDE defaults to Bootstrap.)
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — UI Overview (Layout)

questions.prompt: What does a component do in a CDE dashboard?
options: Links a layout element to a data source — charts, tables, selectors, parameters, scripts
questions.explanation: Components are the central elements that connect layout elements to data sources (charts, tables, selectors, parameters, scripts).
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — UI Overview (Components)

questions.prompt: What is a parameter in a dashboard?
options: A value shared by components — set by inputs and read via Listeners — enabling interaction
questions.explanation: Parameters are shared values; input components set them and other components listen to them, driving interactivity.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — UI Overview (Components)

questions.scenario: You want a chart to refresh whenever the user changes a month selector.
questions.prompt: Which component property wires this up?
options: Listeners — set the chart to listen to the month parameter
questions.explanation: Listeners name the parameters that trigger a component to re-run; listening to the month parameter refreshes the chart on change.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — UI Overview (Components)

questions.prompt: The HtmlObject property of a component holds…
options: The id of the HTML layout element (column) the component renders into
questions.explanation: HtmlObject is the id of the layout column where the component is appended/rendered.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — UI Overview (Components)

questions.scenario: Two components must run in a specific order at load time.
questions.prompt: Which property controls execution order?
questions.explanation: Priority controls load-order; lower numbers have higher priority (default 5).
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — UI Overview (Components)

questions.prompt: What does 'Execute at Start = False' do?
options: Stops the component running on load — it runs only when a listened parameter changes
questions.explanation: With Execute at Start False, the component doesn't run on load and only executes when a parameter it listens to changes.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — UI Overview (Components)

questions.prompt: If a component's preExecution function returns false, what happens?
questions.explanation: preExecution runs before update/render; returning false skips updating that component.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — UI Overview (Components)

questions.prompt: Which charts are supported/recommended in CDE today?
options: CCC2 charts (component names begin with CCC); legacy charts are not supported
questions.explanation: CCC2 charts (prefixed CCC) are added via the Components perspective; other (legacy) charts are not supported.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — UI Overview (Charts)

questions.scenario: A CCC2 chart property you need isn't exposed in the CDE interface.
questions.prompt: How do you set it?
options: Use a CCC extension point, named like <element>_<property> (e.g. xAxisLabel_textAngle)
questions.explanation: Extension points implement Protovis properties not exposed in CCC2, using the format <element>_<property>.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — UI Overview (Charts)

questions.prompt: Which data source type is the recommended way to feed CDE components?
questions.explanation: CDE's Data Sources perspective offers CDA among others; CDA is the standard way to retrieve and combine data for components.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — UI Overview (Data Sources)

questions.prompt: How do you start a new CDE dashboard?
options: In the Pentaho User Console, choose Create New > New CDE Dashboard (or File > New > CDE Dashboard)
questions.explanation: A new CDE dashboard is created in PUC via Create New > New CDE Dashboard (File > New > CDE Dashboard).
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — UI Overview

questions.prompt: What does CGG do with a CCC chart?
options: Renders it on the server and converts the SVG into an image
Converts it to a database table
questions.explanation: CGG draws the same CCC chart on the server as the browser would and converts the SVG into an image.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Graphics Generator — Overview

questions.prompt: Which are reasons to use CGG? (Select all that apply.)
options: Including chart images in Pentaho reports
Rendering charts for browsers with limited SVG capability
Generating a chart via a URL
questions.explanation: CGG is used for report-embeddable chart images, for limited-SVG browsers, and to render charts via a URL — it does not replace CDA.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Graphics Generator — Overview

questions.prompt: How well is CGG integrated with CDE?
options: Fully integrated — it renders the CCC charts you build in CDE
Only via manual export to Excel
questions.explanation: CGG is fully integrated with CDE and renders the same CCC charts created in dashboards.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Graphics Generator — Overview

questions.scenario: A scheduled PDF report needs to embed a chart that normally renders only in the browser.
questions.prompt: How does CGG help?
options: CGG renders the chart server-side as an image the report can embed
It rewrites the report in HTML
questions.explanation: Because CGG produces a server-side image of the chart, that image can be embedded in Pentaho reports.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Graphics Generator — Overview

questions.prompt: CGG renders charts based on which technology?
options: SVG (the same SVG-based CCC charts shown in the dashboard)
questions.explanation: CGG runs SVG-based charts on the server and converts them into images — the same SVG CCC charts shown in the browser.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Graphics Generator — Overview

questions.scenario: You want to fetch a specific dashboard chart as a PNG by hitting a link.
questions.prompt: Which CGG capability is this?
questions.explanation: One of CGG's main features is rendering charts via a URL, returning the chart as an image.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Graphics Generator — Carrier Dashboard Charts

questions.prompt: The Sales Analysis (Retail Sales) dashboard combines which CTools?
options: CDA data sources, CDE layout/components, and CCC charts
questions.explanation: The use case ties it together: CDA queries feed CDE components and CCC charts in a complete dashboard.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Use Cases — Sales Analysis Dashboard

questions.prompt: What is the typical end-to-end CTools dashboard workflow?
options: Design/mock-up → define CDA data sources → build the CDE layout → add components → preview
questions.explanation: You design the dashboard, define its CDA data, lay it out in CDE, wire up components, and preview/iterate.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Use Cases — Sales Analysis Dashboard

questions.scenario: Stakeholders want to agree the look and content before any building starts.
questions.prompt: What's the first deliverable?
options: A mock-up / design of the dashboard (layout, components, interactions)
questions.explanation: Dashboard work starts with a mock-up and a functional breakdown of requirements before building in CDE.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Getting Started — First Steps

questions.scenario: On the finished dashboard, choosing a territory updates every chart and table.
questions.prompt: What makes this work?
options: A selector sets a parameter; the charts/tables listen to that parameter and refresh
questions.explanation: A selector stores the territory in a parameter; components listening to it re-run when it changes — driving the interactive update.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Use Cases — Sales Analysis Dashboard

questions.prompt: Where is a CTools dashboard built and viewed by users?
options: In the Pentaho User Console (the browser)
questions.explanation: CTools dashboards are created in CDE and run in the Pentaho User Console — entirely in the browser.
questions.source: Pentaho BI Developer - CT Practitioner: Community Dashboard Editor — UI Overview
